items.text: GitHub put stacked pull requests into public preview, letting teams split large changes into ordered PRs reviewed in parallel and merged together with automatic rebasing.
items.text_zh: GitHub 将「堆叠式 Pull Request」开放公测，大改动可拆成有序的小 PR 并行评审、一次性合并，并自动 rebase。

items.text: Cognition said Devin now natively supports GitHub stacked PRs, breaking large changes into reviewable diffs and fixing review comments across an entire stack.
items.text_zh: Cognition 宣布 Devin 原生支持 GitHub 堆叠式 PR，可把大改动拆成可评审的小 diff，并跨整个 stack 处理评论修改。

items.text: Cursor said 56% of its merged pull requests now come from cloud agents, up from one in ten last December, as agents take on longer end-to-end tasks.
items.text_zh: Cursor 表示其合并的 PR 中已有 56% 来自云端 agent，而去年 12 月仅十分之一，agent 正承担更长链条的完整任务。

items.text: Microsoft Research unveiled Echoverse, twelve co-evolving synthetic worlds for computer-use agents; a 9B model trained on it jumped from 36.5% to 67.1% across fourteen domains.
items.text_zh: 微软研究院发布 Echoverse——面向电脑操作 agent 的 12 个协同进化合成环境，9B 模型训练后在 14 个领域从 36.5% 提升到 67.1%。

items.text: Microsoft Research introduced EvoLib, which distills a model's own inference-time experience into reusable skills and insights, beating top retrieval-based memory baselines without labels.
items.text_zh: 微软研究院推出 EvoLib，把模型推理时的自身经验提炼成可复用的技能与洞见，无需标注即超越最强检索式记忆方案。

items.text: Google Research published the Science One Framework, an autonomous research agent whose Chain-of-Evidence design produced zero phantom references where baselines hallucinated up to 21%.
items.text_zh: 谷歌研究院发布 Science One 框架，其「证据链」设计让自主科研 agent 实现零虚构引用，而基线系统的引用幻觉率高达 21%。

items.text: Goodfire traced a drunk-driving prompt to two competing neuron sets in Qwen3 and cut harmful endorsements from 30/48 by boosting the five impairment neurons fourfold.
items.text_zh: Goodfire 追踪到 Qwen3 中两组相互竞争的神经元决定酒驾问题的回答，将 5 个「醉酒识别」神经元放大 4 倍后，有害回答从 30/48 明显下降。

items.text: ElevenLabs launched Character Casting in ElevenCreative Audiobooks, auto-detecting every character in a manuscript, proposing voices, and pre-filling pronunciations across chapters.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 在 ElevenCreative 有声书中推出 Character Casting，可自动识别书稿中的所有角色、推荐配音并跨章节预设发音规则。

items.text: Luma AI shipped Layers in Luma Agents, powered by Uni-1, letting users extract editable layers from any generated or uploaded image and keep restyling by chat.
items.text_zh: Luma AI 在 Luma Agents 中上线由 Uni-1 驱动的 Layers 功能，可从生成或上传的任意图片中拆出可编辑图层，并继续对话式改图。

items.text: Krea said off-the-shelf image models failed to learn the Doodles art style, so it trained a custom Krea 2 LoRA with artist Burnt Toast for on-brand output.
items.text_zh: Krea 表示通用图像模型学不会 Doodles 的美术风格，遂与艺术家 Burnt Toast 合作训练专属 Krea 2 LoRA，使出图始终贴合品牌调性。

items.text: Sakana AI's defense and intelligence volunteers placed fifth among 850-plus teams at Diver OSINT CTF 2026, using open-source-intelligence analysis agents built on Fugu-ultra 1.1.
items.text_zh: Sakana AI 防务与情报团队志愿者在 Diver OSINT CTF 2026 中以基于 Fugu-ultra 1.1 的开源情报分析 agent，从 850 余支队伍中夺得第五。

items.text: Okta is acquiring AI identity-security startup Permiso for just under $200 million in a nearly all-cash deal, adding threat detection for AI agents and machine identities.
items.text_zh: Okta 将以近 2 亿美元、几乎全现金的方式收购 AI 身份安全创业公司 Permiso，补强针对 AI agent 与机器身份的威胁检测能力。

items.text: British AI neocloud Nscale is buying Ray creator Anyscale for $1.65 billion, adding a workload-scaling software layer atop its data centers and orchestration business.
items.text_zh: 英国 AI 云厂商 Nscale 将以 16.5 亿美元收购 Ray 团队创办的 Anyscale，在数据中心与调度业务之上补齐负载扩展软件层。

items.text: The FCC's import ban on new Chinese robots and connected power inverters took effect, covering any wireless sensing ground robot over 2kg, including vacuums and mowers.
items.text_zh: 美国 FCC 对中国新款机器人及联网逆变器的进口禁令生效，涵盖 2 公斤以上带传感与无线连接的地面机器人，扫地机与割草机也在内。

items.text: Artificial Analysis scored DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 at 50 on its Intelligence Index and 1559 Elo on agentic GDPval-AA v2, up from 1189.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 测得 DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 智能指数达 50 分，实战 Agent 榜 GDPval-AA v2 从 1189 跃升至 1559 Elo。

items.text: MiniMax H3 went live across third-party creative platforms the same day, including Runway, Krea, Pika's MCP, Lovart, Vercel AI Gateway and Video Arena.
items.text_zh: MiniMax H3 当日即上线多家第三方创作平台，包括 Runway、Krea、Pika MCP、Lovart、Vercel AI Gateway 与 Video Arena。

items.text: Hands-on tests found MiniMax H3 renders hand-drawn effects, script typography and subtitle animation inside generation, defaulting to 2K with native stereo audio.
items.text_zh: 实测显示 MiniMax H3 可在生成过程中直接产出手绘特效、花体字与字幕动画，默认 2K 分辨率并原生输出立体声。

items.text: Alibaba released Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR-Flash, a speech recognition model upgraded for context consistency and domain-term recognition.
items.text_zh: 阿里发布 Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR-Flash 语音识别模型，重点升级上下文一致性与专业术语识别能力。

items.text: Alibaba's Wan added sketch-to-image to its Realtime mode, turning stick figures and rough shapes into finished images as you draw.
items.text_zh: 阿里通义万相在 Realtime 实时模式中上线草图生图，随手画的火柴人或粗略形状可边画边变成成品图。

items.text: Tencent Hunyuan said its open-source Hy-MT2 translation models passed 700,000 downloads since May, with the 1.8B variant topping Hugging Face trending.
items.text_zh: 腾讯混元称开源翻译模型 Hy-MT2 自 5 月发布以来下载量已超 70 万次，其中 1.8B 版本登上 Hugging Face 趋势榜首。

items.text: Nous Research shipped three integration paths letting its Hermes Agent work inside Buzz, Block's Apache-2.0 Nostr workspace shared by humans and agents.
items.text_zh: Nous Research 推出三种集成方式，让 Hermes Agent 接入 Block 开源的 Nostr 协作空间 Buzz，实现人与 agent 同频道协作。

items.text: PolyAI released Dialog-RSN-1, an audio-native model fusing turn-taking, recognition, function calling and response generation with sub-300ms latency on A100s.
items.text_zh: PolyAI 发布 Dialog-RSN-1，将轮次控制、语音识别、函数调用与回复生成融为一体，在 A100 上延迟低于 300 毫秒。

items.text: miHoYo founder Cai Haoyu's studio Anuttacon halted its AI game, chatbot and video model, shifting nearly 90% of compute to LLMs and agents.
items.text_zh: 米哈游创始人蔡浩宇的 Anuttacon 暂停 AI 游戏、聊天机器人与视频模型项目，将近九成算力转向大模型与 Agent 方向。

items.text: Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness sold most of its public book to Citadel after assets halved to $10 billion, but kept its $5 billion Anthropic stake.
items.text_zh: Aschenbrenner 旗下 Situational Awareness 在资产腰斩至 100 亿美元后，将大部分公开持仓卖给 Citadel，但保留 50 亿美元的 Anthropic 股份。

items.text: Reddit beat estimates with $805 million revenue but fell over 10% after hours as US daily users slipped and AI search referrals turned choppy.
items.text_zh: Reddit 季度营收 8.05 亿美元超预期，但美国日活下滑、AI 搜索导流波动，盘后股价跌超 10%。

items.text: Skywork said the first batch of its newly launched AI Hardware Family sold out within a week of the official launch.
items.text_zh: 昆仑万维 Skywork 表示其 AI 硬件家族正式发布一周内首批产品已全部售罄。

items.text: Replit launched Replit Design with hundreds of designer-made templates spanning mobile screens, landing pages and social posts, so builds never start blank.
items.text_zh: Replit 推出 Replit Design，内置数百个设计师制作的模板，涵盖移动端页面、落地页与社交图，避免从空白页起步。

items.text: China's Xuexi Qiangguo app spread an AI community to 68 cities in two weeks, bundling Zhipu, MiniMax, PixVerse and WPS tools into one AI Super Card.
items.text_zh: 学习强国的 AI 星伙社区两周内铺进 68 座城市，以「AI 超级卡」打包智谱、MiniMax、PixVerse、WPS 等工具权益。
